label: Basalt 0.5.0 | UD-IQ4_XS | NVMe | tuned 262k, 2 reps
notes:
Engine: Basalt 0.5.0 (bin/basalt.exe serve), official pack Qwen3.8-FN-UD-IQ4_XS.basalt (huggingface jesdga/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Basalt), served as qwen3.8-flash-next-basalt-ud-iq4_xs.
Hardware: i7-5960X (AVX2, no AVX-512), 64 GB DDR4-2133, 2x RTX 5070 Ti 16 GB at PCIe 3.0 x16; gpu 0,1 (GPU 1 = peer expert tier, peer-exclusive, prompt split off).
Common settings: kv int8, vram-reserve-mib 1024, resident-experts, MTP drafting on (Basalt default spec 8), reasoning-effort none, parallel 1.
Protocol: Wattever generic endpoint, 1 query, 256 output tokens, temperature 0, reasoning none, warmup on, hardware probes deferred; NVFP4 download paused unless noted.
Storage override: THIS run reads a copy of the pack on the Samsung 990 PRO NVMe (SHA-256 verified), after the NVMe was re-plugged (boot 2026-11-21 21:16). The NVMe volume is flagged 'Full Repair Needed' by Windows.
Variant: basalt_config.iq4_xs.nvme.json = same tuned settings as 20261121-120433 (262k, budget 26, share 0.3); auto plan chose peer-excl=on. Loaded in 83 s (SATA 152-192 s).
Purpose: storage effect on Basalt (NVMe vs SATA).
Finding: vs the same-boot SATA control 20261121-212506, prefill is unchanged within noise (Basalt reads only 1.2-7.8% of experts from the drive), decode ~40% faster (median ~75-90 vs ~53 tok/s at 40k-100k) because the 8.3 GiB drive tier is read in small random pieces during generation. vs the older-boot SATA run 20261121-120433, prefill here is 15-30% lower at >=40k: cross-boot variance (desktop VRAM +0.5 GiB, file cache) is larger than the storage effect on prefill.
Metrics (median client values per prompt size; 18 ok, 0 not ok):
  512: prefill 184 tok/s, decode 45.5 tok/s, TTFT 3.0 s (n=2)
  5k: prefill 389 tok/s, decode 70.4 tok/s, TTFT 16.9 s (n=2)
  10k: prefill 742 tok/s, decode 89.7 tok/s, TTFT 14.1 s (n=2)
  20k: prefill 476 tok/s, decode 84.6 tok/s, TTFT 41.5 s (n=2)
  40k: prefill 968 tok/s, decode 89.7 tok/s, TTFT 47.6 s (n=2)
  80k: prefill 1006 tok/s, decode 73.4 tok/s, TTFT 82.1 s (n=2)
  100k: prefill 1118 tok/s, decode 75.1 tok/s, TTFT 89.2 s (n=2)
  150k: prefill 1115 tok/s, decode 64.5 tok/s, TTFT 134.8 s (n=2)
  200k: prefill 918 tok/s, decode 58.7 tok/s, TTFT 218.0 s (n=2)
Comparison caveat: Strata baseline 20261118-022333 (qwen3.8-flash-next-unsloth-ud-iq4_xs) loaded from the NVMe, so it is NOT a 1:1 storage match; a Strata run from SATA C: is pending.
Series: Basalt-vs-Strata tuning chain 2026-11-20/21: 203744 base -> 214949 E1 -> 220131 E2 -> 220704 E3 -> 221211 E4 -> 221744 E5 -> 20261121-120433 shortcut 262k -> 20261121-205631 NVMe -> 20261121-212506 SATA same-boot control. Strata 1:1: SATA 20261121-123019, NVMe see Strata runs of 2026-11-21 evening.

collection.policy: Read-only allow-listed OS/driver probes without elevation; no unique device IDs, host names, network addresses or user paths.

channel_topology.note: Populated channels inferred from explicit firmware channel/slot labels, not DIMM count. Active controller mode is unverified.

memory.note: Channel topology includes its source and detection method; populated channels do not verify active controller mode. Module count does not establish channels. Clocks are firmware/OS reports; measured transfer probes are stored separately.

pcie.maximum_scope: driver-reported platform/adapter limit; physical slot wiring and card lane capability are unverified
pcie.note: Snapshot may show an idle downshift. Reported maxima can reflect platform limits and do not prove the card or physical slot supports that lane count. Encoding ceiling excludes packet/system overhead and is not measured transfer bandwidth.

capabilities.note: No FLOPS/TOPS or device-memory bandwidth measurement was performed. Model quantization bit width is not hardware arithmetic precision; peak compute also depends on operation, clock and sparsity.

capabilities.note: No FLOPS/TOPS or device-memory bandwidth measurement was performed. Model quantization bit width is not hardware arithmetic precision; peak compute also depends on operation, clock and sparsity.

storage_to_ram.note: Sequential reads of a flushed temporary file on the selected volume (results volume by default). File creation is excluded. Device/controller caches may contribute; model files on other volumes need separate measurement.

ram_copy_single.note: Native RAM copy payload throughput. Each payload byte requires a source read and destination write; 2x this rate is logical read+write bandwidth, not measured DRAM bus traffic. Cache/write-allocation effects and worker count influence results.

ram_copy_parallel.note: Native RAM copy payload throughput. Each payload byte requires a source read and destination write; 2x this rate is logical read+write bandwidth, not measured DRAM bus traffic. Cache/write-allocation effects and worker count influence results.

pcie_before.note: Snapshot may show an idle downshift. Reported maxima can reflect platform limits and do not prove the card or physical slot supports that lane count. Encoding ceiling excludes packet/system overhead and is not measured transfer bandwidth.

pcie_during.maximum_scope: driver-reported platform/adapter limit; physical slot wiring and card lane capability are unverified
pcie_during.note: Snapshot may show an idle downshift. Reported maxima can reflect platform limits and do not prove the card or physical slot supports that lane count. Encoding ceiling excludes packet/system overhead and is not measured transfer bandwidth.
